sources: lib/Date/Manip/DM5.pod: CUSTOMIZING DATE::MANIP and DATE::MANIP VARIABLES

keys.domain: any value; value is ignored and restores all configuration defaults
keys.portable_meaning: restore the configuration context to its documented defaults at this point in the ordered settings
partitions: trigger after one and after several preceding settings
interaction with settings following the reset
ambiguities: Whether an empty value is accepted by each binding and the exact error/warning channel are runtime questions.

keys.domain: one operating-system-valid full file path per occurrence; nested and repeated files are documented
keys.documented_default: unknown (no file is specified by Config.pod)
keys.portable_meaning: load configuration assignments and special sections from a named file immediately in ordered configuration processing
ambiguities: Exact path normalization and warning text are runtime-only.

keys.domain: case-insensitive supported language name; finite language list is defined by the release language documentation
keys.portable_meaning: select the language used for language-sensitive date parsing and localized output
ambiguities: The complete DM6 list is delegated to Lang.pod; DM5.pod lists a historical subset. Exact accepted aliases need runtime reconciliation.

keys.domain: one encoding name, or input and output encoding names separated by one comma; either side may be empty; names are supported by Perl Encoding; special input/output name perl is documented
keys.documented_default: input tries language-common encodings and Perl escapes; output UTF-8
keys.portable_meaning: control character decoding of inputs and encoding of outputs
ambiguities: The portable contract needs an encoding registry and exact malformed-comma behavior; Config.pod does not define them.

keys.domain: integer digit 1-7, where 1=Monday and 7=Sunday
keys.portable_meaning: choose the first weekday for week calculations

keys.domain: janX or dowX for digit X 1-7, or firstday
keys.portable_meaning: define which week contains the first week of a calendar year, together with FirstDay
ambiguities: Case sensitivity of the tokens and invalid-setting behavior are not specified.

keys.domain: documented numeric modes 0/default, 1, and 2
keys.portable_meaning: select the legacy printable date serialization
partitions: date with absent or invalid fields
ambiguities: Config.pod describes the default format but does not explicitly state whether the setting accepts only integers.
Documented as backward compatibility and potentially deprecated; removal timing is unspecified.

keys.domain: case-insensitive US or any other value
keys.portable_meaning: choose month/day ordering for ambiguous numeric dates

keys.domain: any integer (including outside 0-99), C, C##, or C####; integer N maps to CURR-N through CURR+(99-N)
keys.portable_meaning: expand a two-digit year into a selected 100-year period
ambiguities: Whether whitespace, signs, and malformed century forms are accepted is runtime-only.

keys.domain: midnight or curr
keys.portable_meaning: supply midnight or the current clock time when a parseable date omits a time
ambiguities: Case sensitivity and invalid-setting behavior are not documented.

keys.domain: boolean-like numeric setting; 1 enables period as a time separator, default disables it
keys.documented_default: 0/disabled (inferred from documented default behavior; exact stored value unknown)
keys.portable_meaning: allow a period in addition to language-defined time separators
ambiguities: Accepted truth values and whether nonzero text is accepted are unspecified.

keys.domain: first or last
keys.documented_default: Legacy day/short-year interpretation rather than direct month/year interpretation; exact stored selector unknown.
keys.portable_meaning: choose first-day or last-day interpretation for month/year forms in the documented grammar
ambiguities: The default's internal setting and invalid-setting behavior are not documented.

keys.domain: integer digit 1-7; must be numerically no later than WorkWeekEnd
keys.portable_meaning: first weekday included in the configured work week

keys.domain: integer digit 1-7; must be numerically no earlier than WorkWeekBeg
keys.portable_meaning: last weekday included in the configured work week

keys.domain: boolean-like; any nonzero value selects a 24-hour work day
keys.portable_meaning: select a work day treated as normally 24 hours, taking DST changes into account
ambiguities: Exact accepted boolean forms and error behavior are not documented.

keys.domain: valid time in H, H:M, or H:M:S form in DM6; DM5 permits any valid time format and ignores seconds; must precede WorkDayEnd
keys.portable_meaning: start of the configured non-24-hour work day
ambiguities: Defaults are not stated; DM5 international time-format acceptance and one-hour minimum need runtime checks.

keys.domain: valid time in H, H:M, or H:M:S form in DM6; DM5 permits any valid time format and ignores seconds; must follow WorkDayBeg
keys.portable_meaning: end of the configured non-24-hour work day
ambiguities: Defaults are not stated; DM5 international time-format acceptance and one-hour minimum need runtime checks.

keys.domain: boolean-like; default/nonzero searches tomorrow first, zero searches yesterday first
keys.portable_meaning: tie-break direction when selecting the nearest business day
ambiguities: Exact accepted values are not documented.

keys.domain: presence with any supplied value; supplied value is ignored
keys.portable_meaning: clear the currently defined holiday set before subsequent configuration-file loading

keys.domain: presence with any supplied value; supplied value is ignored
keys.portable_meaning: clear the currently defined event set before subsequent configuration-file loading

keys.domain: none, year, month, week, day, or all
keys.portable_meaning: choose the default recurrence search range
partitions: fixed current date at each boundary

keys.domain: maximum number of search attempts; accepted numeric domain and default are not documented
keys.portable_meaning: bound recurrence search before declaring a recurrence invalid
ambiguities: The POD explains the role but gives neither default nor validation rules.

keys.domain: now[,ZONE], now,DSTFLAG,ZONE, zone,ZONE, zone,DSTFLAG,ZONE, DATE[,ZONE], or DATE,DSTFLAG,ZONE; DATE is YYYY-MM-DD-HH:MN:SS or YYYYMMDDHH:MN:SS; DSTFLAG std, dst, stdonly, dstonly
keys.documented_default: system current date/time, zone, and DST state
keys.portable_meaning: set an advancing reference clock and optionally its interpretation zone
ambiguities: Zone resolution precedence and exact error state are delegated to timezone behavior.

keys.domain: same forms as SetDate in DM6; DM5 documented fixed DATE YYYY-MM-DD-HH:MN:SS
keys.portable_meaning: set a non-advancing reference clock and optionally its interpretation zone
ambiguities: DM5 does not document the DM6 zone/DST forms; compatibility boundaries need runtime checks.

keys.domain: boolean-like; 1 makes date printf directives match POSIX directives
keys.portable_meaning: select POSIX interpretation for otherwise differing date formatting directives
ambiguities: The default value and accepted truth-value forms are not documented.

keys.domain: time zone name, alias, abbreviation, or offset
keys.documented_default: system-local zone discovery (DM6); DM5 leaves local zone unless set
keys.portable_meaning: legacy way to select the local/current time zone
ambiguities: Config.pod says deprecated and scheduled for removal in 7.00 although it remains documented; actual release behavior and precedence need runtime confirmation.

keys.domain: boolean-like; non-nil selects a first week containing January 1
keys.portable_meaning: legacy override for week-one selection
ambiguities: Deprecated compatibility precedence against Week1ofYear is undocumented and runtime-only.

keys.domain: presence with any value; value ignored; must occur in initial Date_Init call
keys.documented_default: global configuration is read unless this is supplied
keys.portable_meaning: suppress loading of the DM5 global configuration file

keys.domain: regular expression separating paths
keys.documented_default: colon on Unix; semicolon on Win32
keys.portable_meaning: define the separator used in configuration-file search paths
ambiguities: Platform set and regex dialect are environment-dependent.

keys.domain: complete path to a configuration file; tilde expansion on supported platforms
keys.portable_meaning: select the optional DM5 global configuration file

keys.domain: configuration-file name
keys.portable_meaning: select the personal configuration filename searched in PersonalCnfPath

keys.domain: list of paths separated by PathSep; tilde expansion where supported
keys.portable_meaning: define directories searched for the personal configuration file
ambiguities: Default search path is not documented.

keys.domain: blank, a time zone, or IGNORE
keys.portable_meaning: choose the zone in which parsed dates are stored, or ignore zone information

keys.domain: 0 or 1
keys.portable_meaning: select the legacy internal date text shape
partitions: round trip through parse and formatting
ambiguities: Default is not stated in the section.

keys.domain: boolean-like; nonzero restores a sign on every delta component
keys.portable_meaning: select legacy versus consolidated signs when representing negative deltas
ambiguities: Exact accepted truth values are not documented.

keys.domain: boolean-like; nonzero checks the current zone for every date parse
keys.portable_meaning: control whether long-running processes refresh detected current timezone on each parse

keys.domain: 0 or 1
keys.portable_meaning: select ASCII or international character output for localized names
ambiguities: Default is not stated.

keys.domain: boolean-like; true makes today mean midnight today, otherwise current time
keys.portable_meaning: choose the reference time assigned to the relative token today
ambiguities: Exact accepted truth values are not documented.

gaps: Runtime acceptance, warnings, and error channels remain unobserved for every key.
DM6 language names and aliases require reconciliation with Lang.pod and release language modules; this contract records the configuration domain without copying token data.
DM5 defaults inherited from Manip.pm are not all stated in DM5.pod and remain unknown unless the portable contract explicitly labels them unknown.
Configuration-file special-section grammar is a separate obligation; this file records only the ConfigFile entry point and key domains.
Precedence and reset interactions among deprecated DM5 keys and DM6 replacements (TZ/SetDate/ForceDate and Jan1Week1/Week1ofYear) require isolated runtime cases.
